text:
Alicia (sales-eng): EdgeWave signed an LOI; they want a private POC in their AWS GovCloud with BYOK + HSM attestation and 24h ephemeral client certs. Need an infra owner and a short handoff checklist + a four-week cost estimate.

Jonas (infra): I can take infra. Quick Q: do they require FIPS-validated HSM attestation artifact (e.g., Thales) or will AWS CloudHSM attestation suffice? Also which region exactly?

Alicia (sales-eng): They specified us-gov-west-1 and noted preference for Thales but CloudHSM is acceptable if it provides attestation + audit-log exports.

Priya (sec-ops): Standard requirements: attestation statement (signed), firmware/patch evidence, audit log export capability, and documented key compromise procedure. We also require least-privilege wrap/unwrap role and proof nonce test. I'll draft SQA wording.

Jonas (infra): Handoff checklist for customer (draft):
- Provide KMS/HSM attestation doc (PDF/JSON) and public key PEM OR an ARN with wrap/unwrap role.
- Network: VPN peering info + allowlist IPs (we'll send egress list).
- Identity: either a signed CSR or public key; if using KMS provide Key ARN + policy.
- Test: perform wrap/unwrap handshake using a server-provided nonce.
- Ops: contact, rotation window (we suggest 24h), and escalation path.

Jonas (infra): Example CSR we can supply:
```
openssl req -new -nodes -out client.csr -newkey rsa:4096 -keyout client.key -subj "/CN=edgewave-client/O=EdgeWave"
```

Jonas (infra): Ephemeral cert request (example): POST /private/v1/ephemeral-cert {client_pubkey: "<PEM>", requested_ttl: "24h", proof_nonce: "<base64>"}

Alicia (sales-eng): Pricing (POC estimate 4 weeks): $9,500 one-time setup (engineering + attestation support), capped infra for POC: $5,000/week for a small dedicated pool (2x small GPUs), 50% discount if they sign within 45 days. I'll mark as estimate.

Priya (sec-ops): I'll add SQA snippet: "We accept signed HSM attestation and CloudHSM artifacts, provided the attestation includes device identifiers, firmware versions, and signed statement of key provenance. Customer must support audit-log export to us on request and an incident/key compromise runbook."

deploy-bot: Ticket created POC-EDGEW-4821 assigned Jonas, Priya, Alicia. ETA 2026-04-06.

Alicia (sales-eng): Great — scheduling 30m kickoff with the customer tomorrow 11am PT. I'll send checklist + CSR + pricing estimate before the call. Thanks!
